queries.title: Reports still open, by service
queries.method: Reports with no date_closed value and a status that is not a referral, grouped by service_name. Age is the publisher's case_age_days value as of this export; a negative value is treated as not recorded. A report counts as open more than a year when its age exceeds 365 days. Totals cover every service, not only the rows shown. The staff group is the publisher's case_record_type value, the one most open reports of a service carry, with how many carry it.
queries.sql:
WITH service_scope AS (
 SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("service_request_id" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS report_id, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("service_name" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS category, NULL AS area, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("street_address" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS place, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("case_record_type" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS staff_group,
  TRY_CAST(CAST("date_requested" AS VARCHAR) AS TIMESTAMP) AS opened_at, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("date_closed" AS VARCHAR)), '') IS NULL AND NOT COALESCE(CONTAINS(LOWER(CAST("status" AS VARCHAR)), 'refer'), FALSE) AS unresolved,
  NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("date_closed" AS VARCHAR)), '') IS NOT NULL AND NOT COALESCE(CONTAINS(LOWER(CAST("status" AS VARCHAR)), 'refer'), FALSE) AS resolved, COALESCE(CONTAINS(LOWER(CAST("status" AS VARCHAR)), 'refer'), FALSE) AS referred, CASE WHEN TRY_CAST("case_age_days" AS DOUBLE) >= 0 THEN TRY_CAST("case_age_days" AS DOUBLE) END AS age_days
 FROM "analysis_fixture"
), service_reports AS (SELECT * FROM service_scope WHERE category IS NOT NULL), service_open AS (
 SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS open_reports, MEDIAN(age_days) AS median_age_days,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE age_days > 365) AS open_over_one_year, MAX(age_days) AS oldest_age_days, CAST(MIN(opened_at) AS DATE) AS earliest_opened
 FROM service_reports WHERE unresolved GROUP BY category
), service_groups AS (
 SELECT category, staff_group, COUNT(*) AS group_reports FROM service_reports WHERE unresolved AND staff_group IS NOT NULL GROUP BY category, staff_group
), service_owner AS (
 SELECT category, FIRST(staff_group ORDER BY group_reports DESC, staff_group) AS staff_group, MAX(group_reports) AS staff_group_reports FROM service_groups GROUP BY category
), service_backlog AS (
 SELECT service_open.*, staff_group, staff_group_reports FROM service_open LEFT JOIN service_owner ON service_owner.category = service_open.category
)
SELECT *, SUM(open_reports) OVER () AS all_open_reports, SUM(open_over_one_year) OVER () AS all_open_over_one_year
FROM service_backlog ORDER BY open_over_one_year DESC, open_reports DESC, category

queries.title: Open reports older in some areas (council_district)
queries.method: Median age of open reports per service_name and council_district, against the median for that service across all areas. An area is listed with at least 30 open reports, at least three areas reporting, a median at least 1.5 times the all-area median, and either an all-area median of 30 days or more or an area median over 365 days. Age is the publisher's case_age_days value as of this export; a negative value is treated as not recorded.
queries.sql:
WITH service_scope AS (
 SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("service_request_id" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS report_id, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("service_name" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS category, UPPER(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("council_district" AS VARCHAR)), '')) AS area, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("street_address" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS place, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("case_record_type" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS staff_group,
  TRY_CAST(CAST("date_requested" AS VARCHAR) AS TIMESTAMP) AS opened_at, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("date_closed" AS VARCHAR)), '') IS NULL AND NOT COALESCE(CONTAINS(LOWER(CAST("status" AS VARCHAR)), 'refer'), FALSE) AS unresolved,
  NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("date_closed" AS VARCHAR)), '') IS NOT NULL AND NOT COALESCE(CONTAINS(LOWER(CAST("status" AS VARCHAR)), 'refer'), FALSE) AS resolved, COALESCE(CONTAINS(LOWER(CAST("status" AS VARCHAR)), 'refer'), FALSE) AS referred, CASE WHEN TRY_CAST("case_age_days" AS DOUBLE) >= 0 THEN TRY_CAST("case_age_days" AS DOUBLE) END AS age_days
 FROM "analysis_fixture"
), service_reports AS (SELECT * FROM service_scope WHERE category IS NOT NULL), service_area AS (
 SELECT category, area, COUNT(*) AS open_reports, MEDIAN(age_days) AS median_days, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE age_days > 365) AS over_one_year
 FROM service_reports WHERE unresolved AND area IS NOT NULL AND age_days IS NOT NULL GROUP BY category, area
), service_all_areas AS (
 SELECT category, COUNT(DISTINCT area) AS areas, MEDIAN(age_days) AS all_median_days
 FROM service_reports WHERE unresolved AND area IS NOT NULL AND age_days IS NOT NULL GROUP BY category
)
SELECT service_area.*, service_all_areas.all_median_days, ROUND(median_days / all_median_days, 2) AS times_all_areas
FROM service_area JOIN service_all_areas ON service_area.category = service_all_areas.category
WHERE open_reports >= 30 AND areas >= 3 AND (all_median_days >= 30 OR median_days > 365) AND median_days >= 1.5 * all_median_days
ORDER BY over_one_year DESC, open_reports DESC, service_area.category, area

queries.title: Slower closure in some areas (council_district)
queries.method: Median days to close per service_name and council_district, for reports with a date_closed value that were not referred, against the median for that service across all areas. An area is listed with at least 30 closed reports, at least three areas reporting, a median at least 1.5 times the all-area median, and at least seven days slower. Age is the publisher's case_age_days value as of this export; a negative value is treated as not recorded.
queries.sql:
WITH service_scope AS (
 SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("service_request_id" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS report_id, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("service_name" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS category, UPPER(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("council_district" AS VARCHAR)), '')) AS area, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("street_address" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS place, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("case_record_type" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS staff_group,
  TRY_CAST(CAST("date_requested" AS VARCHAR) AS TIMESTAMP) AS opened_at, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("date_closed" AS VARCHAR)), '') IS NULL AND NOT COALESCE(CONTAINS(LOWER(CAST("status" AS VARCHAR)), 'refer'), FALSE) AS unresolved,
  NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("date_closed" AS VARCHAR)), '') IS NOT NULL AND NOT COALESCE(CONTAINS(LOWER(CAST("status" AS VARCHAR)), 'refer'), FALSE) AS resolved, COALESCE(CONTAINS(LOWER(CAST("status" AS VARCHAR)), 'refer'), FALSE) AS referred, CASE WHEN TRY_CAST("case_age_days" AS DOUBLE) >= 0 THEN TRY_CAST("case_age_days" AS DOUBLE) END AS age_days
 FROM "analysis_fixture"
), service_reports AS (SELECT * FROM service_scope WHERE category IS NOT NULL), service_area AS (
 SELECT category, area, COUNT(*) AS closed_reports, MEDIAN(age_days) AS median_days, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE age_days > 365) AS over_one_year
 FROM service_reports WHERE resolved AND area IS NOT NULL AND age_days IS NOT NULL GROUP BY category, area
), service_all_areas AS (
 SELECT category, COUNT(DISTINCT area) AS areas, MEDIAN(age_days) AS all_median_days
 FROM service_reports WHERE resolved AND area IS NOT NULL AND age_days IS NOT NULL GROUP BY category
)
SELECT service_area.*, service_all_areas.all_median_days, ROUND(median_days / all_median_days, 2) AS times_all_areas
FROM service_area JOIN service_all_areas ON service_area.category = service_all_areas.category
WHERE closed_reports >= 30 AND areas >= 3 AND all_median_days >= 1 AND median_days >= 1.5 * all_median_days AND median_days - all_median_days >= 7
ORDER BY closed_reports * (median_days - all_median_days) DESC, service_area.category, area

queries.title: Places reported again and again
queries.method: Open reports sharing the same service_name and the same street_address text, where at least 10 are open and the oldest has been open more than 90 days. The place is the text the publisher recorded; a street name without a number can cover many blocks, and several reports can describe one fault.
queries.sql:
WITH service_scope AS (
 SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("service_request_id" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS report_id, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("service_name" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS category, NULL AS area, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("street_address" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS place, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("case_record_type" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS staff_group,
  TRY_CAST(CAST("date_requested" AS VARCHAR) AS TIMESTAMP) AS opened_at, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("date_closed" AS VARCHAR)), '') IS NULL AND NOT COALESCE(CONTAINS(LOWER(CAST("status" AS VARCHAR)), 'refer'), FALSE) AS unresolved,
  NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("date_closed" AS VARCHAR)), '') IS NOT NULL AND NOT COALESCE(CONTAINS(LOWER(CAST("status" AS VARCHAR)), 'refer'), FALSE) AS resolved, COALESCE(CONTAINS(LOWER(CAST("status" AS VARCHAR)), 'refer'), FALSE) AS referred, CASE WHEN TRY_CAST("case_age_days" AS DOUBLE) >= 0 THEN TRY_CAST("case_age_days" AS DOUBLE) END AS age_days
 FROM "analysis_fixture"
), service_reports AS (SELECT * FROM service_scope WHERE category IS NOT NULL)
SELECT category, place, COUNT(*) AS open_reports, CAST(MIN(opened_at) AS DATE) AS earliest_opened, MAX(age_days) AS oldest_age_days
FROM service_reports WHERE unresolved AND place IS NOT NULL GROUP BY category, place
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10 AND MAX(age_days) > 90 ORDER BY open_reports DESC, category, place

queries.title: Reports referred elsewhere
queries.method: Reports whose status names a referral, per service_name. A service is listed with at least 100 referred reports making up at least a quarter of its reports. Totals cover every service.
queries.sql:
WITH service_scope AS (
 SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("service_request_id" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS report_id, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("service_name" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS category, NULL AS area, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("street_address" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS place, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("case_record_type" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS staff_group,
  TRY_CAST(CAST("date_requested" AS VARCHAR) AS TIMESTAMP) AS opened_at, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("date_closed" AS VARCHAR)), '') IS NULL AND NOT COALESCE(CONTAINS(LOWER(CAST("status" AS VARCHAR)), 'refer'), FALSE) AS unresolved,
  NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("date_closed" AS VARCHAR)), '') IS NOT NULL AND NOT COALESCE(CONTAINS(LOWER(CAST("status" AS VARCHAR)), 'refer'), FALSE) AS resolved, COALESCE(CONTAINS(LOWER(CAST("status" AS VARCHAR)), 'refer'), FALSE) AS referred, CASE WHEN TRY_CAST("case_age_days" AS DOUBLE) >= 0 THEN TRY_CAST("case_age_days" AS DOUBLE) END AS age_days
 FROM "analysis_fixture"
), service_reports AS (SELECT * FROM service_scope WHERE category IS NOT NULL), service_referrals AS (
 SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS reports, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE referred) AS referred_reports
 FROM service_reports GROUP BY category
), service_referral_totals AS (
 SELECT *, ROUND(100.0 * referred_reports / reports, 1) AS referred_percent,
  SUM(reports) OVER () AS all_reports, SUM(referred_reports) OVER () AS all_referred_reports
 FROM service_referrals
)
SELECT * FROM service_referral_totals WHERE referred_reports > 0 ORDER BY referred_reports DESC, category

queries.title: Reports that left the open file, and new ones
queries.method: Reports open in the copy retrieved 2026-09-14 that are not open in the copy retrieved 2026-10-04, and reports open in the later copy that were not open in the earlier one, matched on the publisher's service_request_id. What became of a report that left is read from the later copy and Service fixture, closed: a close date, a referral, or no record in any of them. A close date records that a report was closed, not what work was done.
queries.sql:
WITH earlier_reports AS (
 SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("service_request_id" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS report_id, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("service_name" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS category, NULL AS area, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("street_address" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS place, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("case_record_type" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS staff_group,
  TRY_CAST(CAST("date_requested" AS VARCHAR) AS TIMESTAMP) AS opened_at, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("date_closed" AS VARCHAR)), '') IS NULL AND NOT COALESCE(CONTAINS(LOWER(CAST("status" AS VARCHAR)), 'refer'), FALSE) AS unresolved,
  NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("date_closed" AS VARCHAR)), '') IS NOT NULL AND NOT COALESCE(CONTAINS(LOWER(CAST("status" AS VARCHAR)), 'refer'), FALSE) AS resolved, COALESCE(CONTAINS(LOWER(CAST("status" AS VARCHAR)), 'refer'), FALSE) AS referred, CASE WHEN TRY_CAST("case_age_days" AS DOUBLE) >= 0 THEN TRY_CAST("case_age_days" AS DOUBLE) END AS age_days
 FROM "analysis_earlier_fixture"
), later_reports AS (
 SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("service_request_id" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS report_id, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("service_name" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS category, NULL AS area, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("street_address" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS place, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("case_record_type" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS staff_group,
  TRY_CAST(CAST("date_requested" AS VARCHAR) AS TIMESTAMP) AS opened_at, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("date_closed" AS VARCHAR)), '') IS NULL AND NOT COALESCE(CONTAINS(LOWER(CAST("status" AS VARCHAR)), 'refer'), FALSE) AS unresolved,
  NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("date_closed" AS VARCHAR)), '') IS NOT NULL AND NOT COALESCE(CONTAINS(LOWER(CAST("status" AS VARCHAR)), 'refer'), FALSE) AS resolved, COALESCE(CONTAINS(LOWER(CAST("status" AS VARCHAR)), 'refer'), FALSE) AS referred, CASE WHEN TRY_CAST("case_age_days" AS DOUBLE) >= 0 THEN TRY_CAST("case_age_days" AS DOUBLE) END AS age_days
 FROM "analysis_fixture"
), earlier_open AS (SELECT * FROM earlier_reports WHERE unresolved AND category IS NOT NULL AND report_id IS NOT NULL
), later_open AS (SELECT * FROM later_reports WHERE unresolved AND category IS NOT NULL AND report_id IS NOT NULL
), outcome_rows AS (
 SELECT report_id, resolved, referred FROM later_reports
 UNION ALL SELECT report_id, resolved, referred FROM (
 SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("service_request_id" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS report_id, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("service_name" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS category, NULL AS area, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("street_address" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS place, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("case_record_type" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS staff_group,
  TRY_CAST(CAST("date_requested" AS VARCHAR) AS TIMESTAMP) AS opened_at, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("date_closed" AS VARCHAR)), '') IS NULL AND NOT COALESCE(CONTAINS(LOWER(CAST("status" AS VARCHAR)), 'refer'), FALSE) AS unresolved,
  NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("date_closed" AS VARCHAR)), '') IS NOT NULL AND NOT COALESCE(CONTAINS(LOWER(CAST("status" AS VARCHAR)), 'refer'), FALSE) AS resolved, COALESCE(CONTAINS(LOWER(CAST("status" AS VARCHAR)), 'refer'), FALSE) AS referred, CASE WHEN TRY_CAST("case_age_days" AS DOUBLE) >= 0 THEN TRY_CAST("case_age_days" AS DOUBLE) END AS age_days
 FROM "analysis_closed_fixture"
 )
), outcome_records AS (
 SELECT report_id, BOOL_OR(resolved) AS resolved, BOOL_OR(referred) AS referred FROM outcome_rows WHERE report_id IS NOT NULL AND (resolved OR referred) GROUP BY report_id
), service_left AS (
 SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS left_reports, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE age_days > 365) AS left_over_one_year,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome_records.resolved) AS closed_on_record,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome_records.referred AND NOT outcome_records.resolved) AS referred_on_record,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome_records.report_id IS NULL) AS no_outcome_record
 FROM earlier_open LEFT JOIN outcome_records ON outcome_records.report_id = earlier_open.report_id
 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM later_open WHERE later_open.report_id = earlier_open.report_id) GROUP BY category
), service_arrived AS (
 SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS arrived_reports FROM later_open
 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM earlier_open WHERE earlier_open.report_id = later_open.report_id) GROUP BY category
), service_movement AS (
 SELECT COALESCE(service_left.category, service_arrived.category) AS category, COALESCE(left_reports, 0) AS left_reports,
  COALESCE(left_over_one_year, 0) AS left_over_one_year, COALESCE(closed_on_record, 0) AS closed_on_record,
  COALESCE(referred_on_record, 0) AS referred_on_record, COALESCE(no_outcome_record, 0) AS no_outcome_record, COALESCE(arrived_reports, 0) AS arrived_reports
 FROM service_left FULL JOIN service_arrived ON service_left.category = service_arrived.category
)
SELECT *, SUM(left_reports) OVER () AS all_left_reports, SUM(left_over_one_year) OVER () AS all_left_over_one_year,
 SUM(closed_on_record) OVER () AS all_closed_on_record, SUM(referred_on_record) OVER () AS all_referred_on_record,
 SUM(no_outcome_record) OVER () AS all_no_outcome_record, SUM(arrived_reports) OVER () AS all_arrived_reports, 1 AS outcome_tables
FROM service_movement ORDER BY left_reports DESC, arrived_reports DESC, category

queries.title: Adopted budget of the departments behind the backlog
queries.method: Adopted operating expense per department and fiscal year from Budget fixture, for the two latest fiscal years with rows marked adopted: the sum of amount where budget_cycle is adopted and account_number begins with 5 (the City's expense accounts; accounts beginning with 4 are revenue). A year whose rows carry no budget_cycle is not counted as adopted. A department's budget covers all its work, not one service.
queries.sql:
WITH budget_lines AS (
 SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("dept_name" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS department, TRY_CAST(CAST("report_fy" AS VARCHAR) AS INTEGER) AS fiscal_year, TRY_CAST("amount" AS DOUBLE) AS amount
 FROM "analysis_budget_fixture"
 WHERE LOWER(TRIM(CAST("budget_cycle" AS VARCHAR))) = 'adopted' AND CAST("account_number" AS VARCHAR) LIKE '5%'
), budget_years AS (SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year FROM budget_lines WHERE fiscal_year IS NOT NULL ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC LIMIT 2)
SELECT department, fiscal_year, SUM(amount) AS adopted_expense, COUNT(*) AS budget_rows, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE amount IS NULL) AS unreadable_amounts
FROM budget_lines WHERE fiscal_year IN (SELECT fiscal_year FROM budget_years) AND LOWER(department) IN ('transportation', 'stormwater', 'development services', 'environmental services', 'parks & recreation', 'police')
GROUP BY department, fiscal_year ORDER BY department, fiscal_year DESC
